bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 7
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Delivery, CSN6458, the jet bridge cannot be connected to our aircraft, request airstairs and buses for disembarkation.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6458, Delivery, roger, airstairs and buses will be arranged.

questions.question: What does CSN6458 need?
questions.explanation: 飞行员明确报告 'the jet bridge cannot be connected'（廊桥无法对接），并 'request airstairs and buses for disembarkation'，即需要客梯车和摆渡车下客，故选 C。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL883, Wuhan Ground, after the passing A320, taxi via E, E9 and H to holding point of RWY36L.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: After the passing A320, taxi via E, E9 and H to holding point RWY36L, JAL883.

questions.question: What should JAL883 do first?

options.A: Wait for the A320 to pass.

questions.explanation: 管制员指令以 'after the passing A320' 开头，即先等那架 A320 滑过之后再沿 E、E9、H 滑行至 36L 跑道等待点，所以第一步是等待 A320 通过，故选 A。C 项 'immediately' 与条件指令矛盾。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CCA4102, an unruly passenger is attempting to open the door, we need security on arrival, request priority landing.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4102, Wuhan Approach, roger PANPAN, you are number one.

questions.question: Why is CCA4102 making an urgency call?

options.B: Because a passenger had a stroke.
options.D: Because a passenger tried to open the door.

questions.explanation: 飞行员发出 PANPAN 紧急呼叫时说明原因是 'an unruly passenger is attempting to open the door'，即一名不守规矩的旅客试图打开舱门，故选 D。其余烫伤、中风、走失均未提及。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3367, Wuhan Tower, behind the landing B737, line up RWY36R behind and wait.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff RWY36R, CSN3367.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3367, negative! Line up behind the landing traffic and wait, I say again, behind and wait.

questions.question: What did the pilot misunderstand?

options.B: He thought he was cleared for takeoff.
options.C: He read back the wrong callsign.
options.D: He did not hear the traffic information.

questions.explanation: 管制员原指令是 'line up RWY36R behind and wait'（跟在着陆的 B737 之后进跑道等待），飞行员却复诵成 'Cleared for takeoff RWY36R'，把进跑道等待误当成了起飞许可，管制员随即纠正 'negative! ... behind and wait'，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, BAW668, we have traffic indication at 2 o'clock, 5nm, same level, converging, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW668, it's VFR traffic, maintain 3900m, report the traffic in sight.

questions.question: Where is the VFR traffic?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告冲突飞机位置为 'traffic indication at 2 o'clock, 5nm, same level, converging'，即 2 点钟方位、5 海里、同高度、汇聚飞行，与 B 完全一致。A、C 的高度差和 C 的方位、D 的 15nm 及 diverging 均与原文不符。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1718, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1718, cleared for takeoff, RWY36L, surface wind 030 degrees 12m/s gusting to 22m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 120.6.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 120.6, CCA1718.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1718, 400m climbing. We have low oil pressure indication on No.2 engine, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1718, roger, turn left heading 300, descend to 900m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Turn left heading 300, descend to 900m, request fire service upon landing, CCA1718.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, CCA1718, fire service will be ready. Contact Approach 126.8.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 126.8, thanks, CCA1718.

questions.question: What was the wind condition when CCA1718 took off?
questions.explanation: 起飞许可中管制员通报 'surface wind 030 degrees 12m/s gusting to 22m/s'，地面风 12 米/秒、阵风达 22 米/秒，属于大阵风天气，故选 A。

questions.question: What problem does CCA1718 have?

options.C: Low oil pressure on No.2 engine.

questions.explanation: 飞行员爬升时报告 'We have low oil pressure indication on No.2 engine'，即 2 号发动机出现低滑油压力指示，因此请求返场着陆，故选 C。对话未提发动机火警或起落架、襟翼故障。

questions.question: Which frequency should CCA1718 call finally?
questions.explanation: 对话最后管制员指令 'Contact Approach 126.8'，飞行员复诵 'Approach 126.8'，故最终应联系的频率是 126.8。注意 120.6 是起飞后联系 Departure 的频率，是干扰项。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3388, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 4nm right of track, expect rejoin the route at XS.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 4nm right of track, CSN3388.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CSN3388, we have weather indication 40nm ahead of us, request deviate to the left for 20nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3388, negative, restricted area is active, can you accept deviation to the right?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 120 for 22nm, CSN3388.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3388, turn right heading 120, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Right heading 120, wilco, CSN3388.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CSN3388, we are losing fuel from the right wing tank, we are emergency descending to 4500m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3388, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, emergency descent between XS and DA, all aircraft below 8100m, leave the route to the north.

questions.question: How did the pilot of CSN3388 plan to avoid the weather?

options.A: Deviate to the right side for 22nm.
options.B: Deviate to the left side for 20nm.
options.D: Deviate to the left side for 40nm.

questions.explanation: 题目问飞行员『计划』如何绕飞：他最初的请求是 'request deviate to the left for 20nm'（向左绕飞 20 海里），故选 B。A 项向右 22 海里是被管制员否决左绕后改用的实际方案，不是最初的计划。

questions.question: Why was the left deviation not approved?

options.C: Because a restricted area was active.

questions.explanation: 管制员否决左绕时明确说明 'negative, restricted area is active'，即限制区正在活动，故选 C。受限区（restricted area）与禁区（prohibited area）、危险区（danger area）是不同概念，B、D 为干扰项。

questions.question: What happened to CSN3388?

options.D: Fuel leak from the right wing tank.

questions.explanation: 飞行员发出 MAYDAY 时报告 'we are losing fuel from the right wing tank'，即右机翼油箱漏油，故选 D。对话中没有提到雷击、失压或发动机火警。

questions.question: Where is CSN3388 when it started emergency descent?
questions.explanation: 管制员向全体通报 'emergency descent between XS and DA'，说明紧急下降发生在 XS 与 DA 之间；飞行员同时宣布 'emergency descending to 4500m'，故选 A。8100m 是要求其他飞机避让的高度界限，不是 CSN3388 所在高度。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CSN8890, 6nm final, established ILS, RWY36.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN8890, Wuhan Tower, cleared to land, RWY36, wind 020, 9m/s, gusting up to 19m/s. QNH1009.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36, CSN8890.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN8890, going around, windshear!

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN8890, roger, climb to 900m, turn right heading 040. All stations, Wuhan Tower, windshear reported on final RWY36. Break Break. AFR331, this is Tower, expect delay for approach due to windshear.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, AFR331, roger, request hold over the field for 15 minutes before the approach.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR331, hold at HZ, 1500m, expect approach at 45.

questions.question: Why did CSN8890 go around?
questions.explanation: 飞行员在进近时直接报告 'going around, windshear!'，复飞原因是遭遇风切变，故选 B。

questions.question: What did the controller broadcast to all stations?

options.A: Windshear was reported on final RWY36.

questions.explanation: 管制员对全体台的广播原文是 'All stations, Wuhan Tower, windshear reported on final RWY36'，即 36 号跑道五边有风切变报告，与 A 一致；并未宣布关闭跑道或命令所有飞机复飞。

questions.question: What did AFR331 request?

options.C: To hold for 15 minutes before the approach.

questions.explanation: AFR331 明确请求 'request hold over the field for 15 minutes before the approach'，即进近前在机场上空等待 15 分钟，故选 C。管制员随后给其 'hold at HZ, 1500m' 的等待指令也印证了这一点。
